caelestia.role: Initial upstream source baseline; local port commits follow this commit.

quickshell.role: Windows backend and QML compatibility interfaces. Preserves nunreasonable/quickshell e8ae0ef124b1c14b547c80d00422d2ffbd423d81, native mask hover handoff, Core Audio capability/error reporting, UPower observation validity, GSMTC initialization/session-scan status, profile-isolated artwork caching, verified power profile results, confirm-only Bluetooth pairing, opt-in strict brightness routes with owned gamma restoration, explicit-consent notification mirroring, and native global shortcuts with shell-config keybind overrides.

iiWindowsReference.role: Porting and packaging reference. Its sources.lock supplies the backend pin; it is not the Caelestia UI dependency.
